items.statement: Freight cost impact on Q3 FY25 EBITDA was INR6 crores quarterly; expects partial normalization in Q4
items.quote: The indication I can give you is the impact of freight costs, if you look at it from last year to current year, is about INR6 crores.

items.statement: Promoters converted warrants worth INR 17 crores into equity in the current financial year, with the remaining 50% to be converted next year.
items.quote: Only promoters have converted about 17 crores worth of warrants into equity. And the reason I always explain, you see in the current stock exchange rules, if you are having acquisition of more than 5% on a basis, it triggers certain other rules. So we wanted to be very careful. That's why we want to divide into two financial years. So 50% conversion was done here and 50% will be done in the next f

items.statement: Operating cash flow positive Rs 175 crore for 9 months and Rs 32 crore for Q3 FY25
items.quote: Further, with respect to cash flows, cash flow from operations for 9 months was positive Rs. 175 crores and from this quarter it was around Rs. 32 crores.

items.statement: Preferential issue of Rs 150 crore at Rs 640 per share; 25% received, balance 75% expected
items.quote: So, we have already received the 25% committed amount from the investors and with respect to balance, obviously, this is a long-term investment which our investors have shown on us.

items.statement: Income tax issue from September 2023 believed closed with no further notices or demands
items.quote: With respect to income tax, whatever we had issue last year, later on there was no notices and no responses, anything from the income tax side and what we believe is and what we understand from the department as well that the issue is closed from there end

items.statement: Management declined to comment on promoter stake sale
items.quote: I would not like to , the company would not like to comment on the promoter stake sale where you are running the business on a day-to-day basis as part of management, and whatever questions you have on the company, happy to answer, but on promoter stake sale, unfortunately I would not be able to comment.

items.statement: Board deliberated on fundraising options; definitive disclosure expected by end of month
items.quote: We outlined it in the outcome of the Board meeting as well yesterday that the Board deliberated on the options that were put in front of the Board. So, we're very hopeful that by the end of this month, there will be something definitive that we can disclose to all investors through an exchange filing.

items.statement: Kaycee Industries stake diluted by 0.05% in last quarter, now holding 71.91%; further dilution possible if good opportunity arises
items.quote: And sir, lastly, you have already diluted another 0.05% in Kaycee Industries in the last quarter, and you are holding around 71.91% now. Is there any further plan of diluting the stake going ahead in this quarter or in the next year? Rajesh Doraiswamy: If we see some good opportunity, yes. Otherwise, we have no

items.statement: Negative operating cash flow due to long aquaculture cycle, processing, extended transit and credit periods
items.quote: Because that's since we are on aquaculture company, when we if we are growing more of our Shrimps, the culture period itself is 120 to 150 days. Then the processing will take one month. Then the export transit period is taking now the transit period because of all this rent fee issue and all from 40 days is gone to 60 days.

items.statement: Factoring arrangement planned to get cash immediately after shipment
items.quote: So definitely, now we are working on some factoring where the once we go for a factoring arrangement, we will get the cash immediately after shipment, but maybe the factoring company will collect from the customer at a later date.

items.statement: NCD outstanding approximately INR 16.45 crores redeemable over next four years
items.quote: It is approximately INR 16.45 crores outstanding NCDs upon date.

items.statement: Cash balance of INR 64 crore as of December 2024 invested in treasury, fixed deposits and mutual funds
items.quote: we have strong cash position of INR 64 crores which has been invested in treasury functions and fixed deposits and mutual funds.

items.statement: Trade receivables decreased from INR 77 crore in H1 to INR 55 crore as of December 2024
items.quote: The current receivable that we have is about INR55 crore. So whatever was billed in Q2, we've realized it.

items.statement: Net working capital at 140 days due to government managed services contracts
items.quote: our net working capital in terms of number of days is about 140 days.

items.statement: Consolidated gross debt is around Rs 78 crore excluding Jaipur subsidiary; Jaipur subsidiary has Rs 12 crore loan and Rs 15 crore cash.
items.quote: Yeah. So our gross debt on books in our balance sheet is around %78 crores, okay, including the subsidiaries, excluding the Jaipur one. Jaipur, because we are not consolidating, so we're not putting. In Jaipur, it is 12 crores. But we have enough cash actually to handle it.

items.statement: Consolidated cash balance is around Rs 260 crore including Jaipur and Goa.
items.quote: Around 260 crores are there.

items.statement: Applications filed for strategic NBFC acquisition from within the group to create credit products for merchants and MSMEs.
items.quote: We are in the process of working with the regulator to look at a strategic NBFC acquisition from within the group so that we can use it as a platform to create our own credit products for our captive merchant base, as well as MSME around the merchants.

items.statement: Amalgamation of Spice Money subsidiary into DiGiSPICE Technologies is underway since August 2024, pending statutory approvals.
items.quote: And also finally, in terms of amalgamation of Spice Money , which is today sitting as a subsidiary of DiGiSPICE Technologies to merge it into DiGiSPICE. Effectively, you know, our subsidiary which is Spice Money, our FinTech business, will get merged into DiGiSPICE Technologies.

items.statement: Float balance of approximately Rs. 130 crores maintained in opened bank accounts, generating recurring float income.
items.quote: One big thing that we have started generating float income, which is a recurring set of revenue stream for us from these accounts. So , almost 130 crores is a balance that we maintain in these accounts today, and which is helping us generate a float value also.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents were around Rs. 65 crores as of December 2024.
items.quote: As of December '24, the group's gross debt stood at Rs. 431 crores and cash and cash equivalents was around Rs. 65 crores reflecting in a net debt of approximately Rs. 366 crores.

items.statement: Kaizen Logistics acquisition almost completed; new company due diligence ongoing, expected to close in March if auditors clear it
items.quote: Kaizen Logistics transaction is already almost completed. And the new company due diligence is going on, so we need clearance from them, we can go ahead to buy this company.

items.statement: Acquiring 99% of target companies, retaining 1% for incumbent management sentiment
items.quote: Sir, 99% of the company we are acquiring , 1% because we have some sentiment with the company, so we are giving them only 1%.

items.statement: Income tax search conducted at facilities and offices; no written communication received yet on outcome; operations running smoothly.
items.quote: the income tax authorities conducted the search operation at our facilities and offices. The company fully cooperated with the investigating office rs. Since the conclusion of the search till date the company has not received any written communication from the IT department regarding the outcome of the search operation

items.statement: Promoters committed to business and will infuse equity if required, but prefer funding growth from internal cash flows
items.quote: We are totally committed to the business, if the business requires us to pump in more equity. We are - our endeavor right now is to sort of fuel our growth from the cash flows that we generate.

items.statement: Company remains a very low debt company with a strong balance sheet
items.quote: We remain a very low debt company with a strong balance sheet.

items.statement: Promoter sold negligible stake; proceeds reinvested in group companies
items.quote: we have sold a fractional, very negligible shareholding. Two thing that if you all recall that we were supposed to dilute our stake by selling to LT1, and it did not happen because of their inability to fulfill the agreement.
